<thought>Search for a template that converts an aromatic hydroxyl group to a methoxy group (substitution of phenol with a methyl halide), which can serve as the third step to introduce the methoxy substituent on the anisole ring.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["methoxy"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
